ai.label: AI
ai.eyebrow: This sounds like an AI opportunity
ai.headline: You're not the first to ask this — and here's what we usually find.
ai.sub: Most teams that come to us saying "we need AI" already have the right instinct — they just don't know where the first 45 days of work actually should go. Whether it's prompt engineering, RAG, an agent, or a full ML pipeline, the wins come from picking the right *first* problem.
bullets: Start with the workflow that costs the most human hours, not the shiniest one
Ship something that actually replaces a step — not a demo that sits in a slide
Instrument every prediction so you can improve it in week 2, not month 6

custom-software.label: Custom software
custom-software.headline: Custom software is our home turf — 130+ platforms shipped.
custom-software.sub: The teams we work with usually come to us after a template solution stopped fitting, or after an offshore build didn't ship. What we do differently: fixed 45-day cadence, one accountable engineering lead, and every phase ends in something you can actually use.
bullets: Web, mobile, and enterprise platforms — one team, one accountable lead
Fixed 45-day cadence per phase, so you know what week you're in
We ship to production, not to a staging demo

product-interest.label: Product interest
product-interest.headline: Two live products — pick the one that fits.
product-interest.sub: OnPoint Nexus ships two SaaS products of our own: DinePoint (an AI menu platform used across India's hospitality sector) and PulseWork OS (an AI Work OS for mid-size teams). We also have AdPoint on the way. Happy to walk you through whichever one sparked the question.
bullets: DinePoint — AI-first menu, ordering, and analytics for restaurants
PulseWork OS — a unified Work OS with AI copilots baked into every module

general-inquiry.label: General inquiry
general-inquiry.headline: Let's find out if we're a fit.
general-inquiry.sub: OnPoint Nexus is an AI engineering studio — we build production AI, cloud, and custom software for teams that need to ship on a deadline. Fastest way to figure out if we're right for you is a short call — no pitch, just a scoping conversation.
bullets: Fixed 45-day delivery cadence, one accountable engineering team
45 minutes on a call and you'll know if it's a fit
